cost.note: rules only: 0 LLM calls, CPU only

limitations: Detectors are rules tuned on the shapes in this dataset (tool names, FR/Arabizi phrasing). New tools or languages need new patterns; the LLM review only sees findings the rules already raised (no recall gain).
Synthetic sessions are cleaner than real traffic; the scores below are an upper bound for real logs.
Ambiguous cases (reminders after silence, hedged wording) are surfaced as needs-review, not counted as failures.
On this app's data, 'tool calls' are the pipeline steps (extraction, scoring, drafting, judge, send) rebuilt from the database, not a live agent trace.
